label: Hidden gem weight
definition: Relevance is lowered by this times the song's popularity percentile / 100, so a much-streamed song needs a closer match to be picked. A song with no streaming data counts as average (50th percentile, median streams per day).

label: Minimum length
definition: In seconds. A track shorter than this is not recommended after a longer song: a short linking track is not a like-for-like pick. Length decides, not the title.

label: Variety lambda
definition: MMR: each pick maximizes lambda x relevance - (1 - lambda) x its similarity to songs already picked (audio closeness, or 1 for the same first release). 1 = relevance only.
